comments.author: elrichzann
comments.body_html:
Just remember, after editing the files you lose any right to complain about the mod not working as intended, you’re essentially “Voiding” your warranty for support for this mod. Hence why he probably said you can’t do it. Either that or he desperately wants you to experience this mod the way he intended

Go into the mod files, find Oni/db/base.json and make a backup. Next open it using a code editor (I use Visual Studio, some use Notepad++) and add the ID of the category you want her to be able to buy here. (It’s basically at the top of the code)

“items_buy”: {
“category”: [
“57864a3d24597754843f8721”

Add a comma after the “number” like so and add new quotes for the category you’re adding.

“items_buy”: {
“category”: [
“57864a3d24597754843f8721”,

“INSERT CATEGORY ID HERE”

Use https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search to find the ID of the category. For example, I use the key, weapon, and equipment categories, so my file looks like this:

“items_buy”: {
“category”: [
“57864a3d24597754843f8721”,
“543be5e94bdc2df1348b4568”,
“5422acb9af1c889c16000029”,
“543be5f84bdc2dd4348b456a”

Save and load up the game. I’ve already tested this, and it works.
